hints.title: Offline Query Processing
hints.text: Sort the queries in ascending order of their edge weight limits.

hints.title: Sort Graph Edges
hints.text: Sort all edges by weight in ascending order.

hints.title: Incremental Disjoint Set Union
hints.text: Maintain disjoint sets via union-find, adding all edges with weight strictly below current query limit, then check if query vertices are connected.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.time: O(E log E + Q log Q)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running graph searches per query takes O(Q * (V + E)), timing out for 10^5 queries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting queries and edges allows two pointers across edges with DSU in near linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies offline query sorting as key technique for dynamic connectivity with weight limits.
